digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and close gate
propositions: Tickets exceeding 24,000 char context bound cannot reach closed state without --force-close, blocking correctly merged work from transitioning to closed status

Recovery failure messaging incorrectly reports missing dependencies (install agents extra) for step-budget exhaustions that demonstrably ran the model, due to failure cause detection keying off exception type rather than measured cause
The criteria budget (32,000 chars) exceeds the context budget (24,000 chars) creating incoherent bounds where criteria sets pass all criteria checks but fail on context validation
Context cap must be raised to 100,000 chars and remain at or above the criteria budget, pinned by an invariant test, to accommodate real tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) with adequate headroom

Over-capacity context should be refused rather than compacted, because elision in an epic context (which concatenates one ticket block per child) silently deletes entire child tickets and their unmet acceptance criteria while misreporting only comment removal
